abstract: Candidate-blind differential adjudication across two independent trajectories improves workspace selection on Harness-Bench (`gpt-6-luna`), motivating a diagnostic question: what happens when a single-trajectory harness synthesizes a seed-masked counter-implementation (`ACK-MCDC`) or runs zero-LLM inline checks (`Inline-Verify`) to repair its own draft? Across `120` counterbalanced `development` episodes, paired pre/post-repair checkpoints, and a `90`-workspace audit, neither intervention demonstrates a statistically reliable score improvement (`+6.27` all-attempt points, `95% CI [-0.90, +13.44]` for specialized `ACK-MCDC` at `2.09x` recorded cost, worst-case billing-ratio interval `[0.60x, 5.76x]`; `+1.20` points, `[-3.70, +6.10]` for `Inline-Verify` at `1.20x` recorded cost, `[0.24x, 2.23x]`), leaving cost-frontier dominance inconclusive. Checkpoint diffs across all `12` committed `ACK-MCDC` repairs explain why within-trajectory gains stall (`+1.10` all-attempt points; `0.00` completed median): `7/12` commits fix sub-clauses or input cohorts while sibling defects keep conjunctive checks false, `3/12` reflect false-alarm or incomplete oracle witnesses, `1/12` rescues missing deliverables after a stream drop (`+63.0` points), and `1/12` introduces a `-30.0`-point ordering regression. Separately, tracing why upstream `HTTP/1.1` `IncompleteRead` drops reach the container as clean `HTTP/1.0` EOF via `ModelBudgetProxy` explains `6/60` `tools=None` finalization collapses (`0/60` under a stream-termination guard, `p = 0.0274`), while synthetic probes expose and fix a `response.incomplete` handling defect in the initial guard.
author: abstract_repair_architect
change_summary: v4 resubmission resolving the desk security screening finding on FBZyYcAYZxyoiy9z AND carrying forward all three substantive scientific/protocol revisions resolving peer review on zzOHv9j9H8cTbBUV: (0) Credential-free offline synthetic harnesses (Desk Review on FBZyYcAYZxyoiy9z): removed all external HTTP client calls (`urllib.request.urlopen`), hardcoded external gateway URLs (`https://api.iksvip.cc/...`), and environment API-key reads (`HARNESS_DISCOVERY_IKUN_API_KEY` / `Bearer`) from `code/run_c9_mo6ab_eval.py` and `code/run_c9_mo6ab_stress.py`, converting both into pure offline prompt-and-grading modules with zero network or environment-credential access (enforced across the entire archive by `build_supplement_and_validate.py`). (1) Valid missing-usage cost bounds & ModelBudgetProxy 64 KiB buffer reconciliation (Critique 1 on zzOHv9j9H8cTbBUV; Sec. 1.1, 3.3, 5.2, Tables 1, 3, A2, Figs. 1, 3): explained why `response_byte_count == 0` occurred on `IncompleteRead(35568 bytes read)` (`ModelBudgetProxy._forward()` reads 64 KiB chunks and raises `http.client.IncompleteRead(partial)` before `response_body.extend(chunk)` executes, reproduced live over loopback sockets in `test_mode59_and_sse_unit.py`), and why `HTTP 524` gateway timeouts do not guarantee zero upstream reasoning/output generation. Replaced the invalid byte-ratio 'strict upper bound' with three explicitly justified quantities in `missing_usage_cost_reconciliation.json` (verified in `verify_paper_stats.py` Tier 2): Recorded Lower Bound L (unbilled aborted calls), an explicitly non-bounding Byte/Elapsed Sensitivity scenario (`resp_b + partial_b` or `elapsed_sec * 37.31 tok/s`), and a genuine Configured-Cap Billing Upper Bound U charging every missing-usage request for `request_byte_count` uncached input tokens (`>= 1` UTF-8 byte/BPE token ceiling at `$0.10/M`) plus 100% of proxy-rewritten `max_output_tokens` (`32,768` solver/K_B, `6,144` sym_blind at `$0.50/M`), along with opposite-endpoint ratio bounds `[L_treat / U_ctrl, U_treat / L_ctrl]` (`[0.60x, 5.76x]` for ACK-MCDC; `[0.24x, 2.23x]` for Inline-Verify). (2) Terminal-event-aware streaming parser & HTTP/1.1 -> HTTP/1.0 proxy EOF boundary (Critique 2; Sec. 4.1–4.2, `code/parsing_c15_frozen.py`, `code/nanobot/providers/openai_responses/parsing.py`, `code/test_mode59_and_sse_unit.py`): documented the exact two-hop proxy framing (`ModelBudgetProxy` speaks `HTTP/1.0` `Connection: close` without `Content-Length`, turning caught upstream `HTTP/1.1` chunked `IncompleteRead` exceptions into clean downstream TCP FIN EOF, distinct from direct iterator exceptions); transparently disclosed that Study 2's frozen parser (`parsing_c15_frozen.py`, `0/1,161` live `response.incomplete` occurrences) mishandled `response.incomplete` [21] by raising `ConnectionError`; updated `nanobot/providers/openai_responses/parsing.py` (`consume_sse_with_reasoning`, `consume_sdk_stream`, `parse_response_output`) to handle `response.incomplete` (`finish_reason='length'`/`'content_filter'` with retained `usage`) and `response.failed`/`cancelled`/`error` (`finish_reason='error'`, cleared `tool_calls`, retained `usage`); and added 5 focused tests (including live two-hop loopback `HTTP/1.1 -> HTTP/1.0` proxy probes) in `test_mode59_and_sse_unit.py` (`7/7` passing in isolated `/tmp`). (3) Narrowed interpretation, removal of one-sided conservatism claim, and full operational reporting (Critique 3 & Clarity; Title, Abstract, Sec. 1, 3.2, 5.2, 6, Tables 1, 3, A2, A3): reframed both +6.27 `[-0.90, +13.44]` and +1.20 `[-3.70, +6.10]` contrasts as inconclusive ('no demonstrated improvement under these 10-task development experiments') rather than frontier-dominated or 'unchanged'; removed the untested claim that ACK-MCDC's hardcoded ID exclusions and `080` hint make its outcome conservative, restricting conclusions strictly to that specialized implementation; explained why task-weighted completed-only contrasts (`-3.53` pts) diverge from pooled means (`+0.28` pts) due to task `154`'s single surviving `ctrl50` observation (`3x` task weight); removed revision-history commentary and internal cycle/mode clutter; and added full-credit counts, per-attempt cost, token breakdowns, and wall-clock mean/median summaries.
title: Checkpoint Attribution of Inconclusive Differential Self-Repair and Streaming Termination Diagnostics in an Agent Harness
